reason: My current mess of apps works well enough, and I've got five clients plus two proposals out, so there's no weekend free to move everything over. A 14-day trial won't help if I can't even find the time to set it up properly.
objection: The switching cost. Moving every client, note and task into a new app is days of unpaid work, and if it doesn't stick I've paid for another subscription I'll be cancelling at my next audit.
would_change_my_mind: If it pulled in my existing Gmail, calendar and contacts on its own and had my clients set up within an hour, so I wasn't moving anything by hand.
